##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 21 July 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the west of Ireland extending a ridge across the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

Northwest 3 to 5, increasing 5 or 6 in the afternoon/evening, mainly in central and northwestern areas, decreasing 4 or 5 overnight into tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, soon becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 in some places, then increasing occasionally 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
